## Checklist

- [ ] One entry in `index.json` (an update changes the existing entry: new `version`, `download`, `size`, `sha256`, `updated`)
- [ ] The entry came from D5 Mod Kit's **Browse Mods › Share my mod…** (or matches the uploaded zip byte for byte)
- [ ] The zip is a GitHub release asset or a file in a GitHub repository
- [ ] A picture in `previews/<uid>.png` (16:9, about 640 × 360, under 1 MB)
- [ ] It's my own work, or I have permission and credit the people it's based on
- [ ] I tested it in the game
